boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named FGCU destinations for studying, meeting, recreation, art, music, events, and hands-on learning, selected from current university sources.

cards.title: Set Up a Focus Session at Bradshaw Library
cards.subtitle: Study spaces, computer labs, and classrooms in the main library
cards.notes: Bring your Eagle ID and choose a study area or computer lab; check library guidance before planning group work or an extended session.
cards.short_summary: A practical academic base with multiple ways to work between classes.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU identifies Wilson G. Bradshaw Library as its main library and says it contains study spaces, computer labs, and classrooms.
cards.access_notes: Multiple accessible entrances are available; library study spaces, computer labs, and classrooms are described as accessible.

cards.title: Use the Library Lawn for the Event Between Classes
cards.subtitle: Four lawn sections linking the library, student union, plaza, and Academic Core
cards.notes: Check the campus calendar, then approach from the bordering walkways; the lawn supports scheduled events, tabling, and everyday use.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor connector that doubles as a flexible campus gathering area.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU says Library Lawn has four grass sections for tabling and everyday use and hosts many campus events.
cards.access_notes: Grass sections are bordered by accessible walkways connecting to the Student Plaza, student union, library, and Academic Core.

cards.title: Meet Your Group at Cohen Student Union
cards.subtitle: Dining, activities, meeting rooms, and student-organization gathering space
cards.notes: Use Cohen as a meetup point, or submit the appropriate event request when your student organization needs a reservable room.
cards.short_summary: The union combines everyday errands with structured space for campus groups.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU describes Cohen Student Union as a gathering place for dining, entertainment, co-curricular activities, and other daily needs.
cards.access_notes: Building hours and holiday adjustments are posted on the official page; room use may require an advance reservation.

cards.title: Bring the Assignment to the CAA
cards.subtitle: Academic coaching, tutoring, supplemental instruction, and writing consultations
cards.notes: Choose the service that matches your assignment and arrange a consultation; the main office is on Library West’s first floor.
cards.short_summary: A named academic-support destination for targeted help beyond solo studying.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU says the Center for Academic Achievement offers academic coaching, tutoring, supplemental instruction, and writing consultations in Library West.
cards.access_notes: The main office is on Library West’s first floor; writing and tutoring services are on the second floor, with elevator access available.

cards.title: Walk Through the Student-Run Food Forest
cards.subtitle: A botanical garden of tropical and subtropical edible species
cards.notes: Visit between sunrise and sunset, follow posted garden etiquette, and use the official involvement link if you want to help.
cards.short_summary: A living campus landscape where food systems and student stewardship meet.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU identifies the Food Forest as a student-run botanical garden and says it supports educational and service-learning opportunities.
cards.access_notes: Open to the community from sunrise to sunset; it is near the main entrance road, past Sugden Welcome Center and beside Kleist Health Center.

cards.title: Plan a Lake Como Recreation Break
cards.subtitle: FGCU’s designated student swimming and sunbathing area
cards.notes: Confirm the posted Waterfront status before leaving campus core, bring your Eagle ID, and follow staff and weather instructions.
cards.short_summary: A student recreation facility centered on the campus lake rather than a public beach.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU says the Waterfront at Lake Como is its designated swimming and sunbathing area for students and supports activities including sailing and kayaking.
cards.access_notes: Not intended for public use; current operating status and weather closures should be checked on the recreation page before visiting.

cards.title: Build a Workout Around the Rec Center
cards.subtitle: Fitness, open-gym activities, and wellness programming for the FGCU community
cards.notes: Check facility and open-gym calendars first, then bring your Eagle ID and request checkout equipment at the front desk if needed.
cards.short_summary: An indoor recreation hub with both individual and organized activity options.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU says the University Recreation & Wellness Center serves the FGCU community and supports fitness and recreation programming.
cards.access_notes: Access depends on current membership eligibility; facility hours and open-gym availability are posted online and may change.

cards.title: Check Lane Availability Before a Swim
cards.subtitle: Open-swim lanes and aquatic equipment checkout
cards.notes: Review the daily lane calendar and lightning status, then bring your Eagle ID if you plan to borrow swim-training equipment.
cards.short_summary: A schedule-driven pool option for lap swimming and aquatic training.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU publishes open-swim hours and a daily lane-availability calendar for the Lee County/FGCU Aquatics Center.
cards.access_notes: Check current hours and lane availability before arrival; pools clear when lightning is detected within the university’s stated radius.

cards.title: See What Is Showing at Wasmer Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Major exhibitions and events inside the Arts Complex
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition listing, visit during posted gallery hours, and ask staff before photographing any displayed work.
cards.short_summary: A campus exhibition room for encountering contemporary art between academic commitments.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU identifies Wasmer Art Gallery in the Arts Complex as a space hosting major exhibitions and events.
cards.access_notes: During exhibitions, posted hours are Monday through Friday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; closed weekends and university and federal holidays.

cards.title: Catch a Student Performance at U. Tobe Recital Hall
cards.subtitle: The Music Building’s recital venue for ensembles and student recitals
cards.notes: Review the concert calendar for a student recital or ensemble date, note any exception, and arrive early enough to find your seat.
cards.short_summary: A compact performance hall where campus music moves from rehearsal to audience.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU says U. Tobe Recital Hall hosts student recitals and ensemble performances in the Music Building.
cards.access_notes: Consult the current concert listing for date, time, venue, and any exception to the series’ general ticket policy.
